notes: CNB Technology (cnbtec.com) blocks all direct access (HTTP 403). ManualsLib installation guides for XNET series (IVC5055VR, IDC4000T, IBP5030CR, IDP4030VR) only document RTSP port numbers (default 554 for MPEG4, 8554 for MJPEG) without providing RTSP path strings. No official CNB CGI/API developer guide or stream URL documentation was found via web search or direct fetch. All sources with URL paths (e.g. /mpeg4) are third-party aggregators, not manufacturer documentation.
